player_prompt.intro:
Ni wowe Umukinnyi {player_id} muri {num_rounds}-teranyo ya IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Muri kila teranyo, teja nambari hagati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.
Nyuma yo guteja, inshuro ni (2/3)x(umwemerera wa guteja zote mbili),
na umukinnyi ugteje nambari iliyo hafi ya inshuro yatsinze iri teranyo.
Sobanura teja yawe muri mfumo wa '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ibirimo ntibikwiye; nyamuneka bandika igishushanyo cyawe nka [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Gufata umwanzuro ugomba kuba uri hagati ya {min_guess} na {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Umukinnyi 0 yiteje {guess0}; Umukinnyi 1 yiteje {guess1}. Kwa hivyo Inshuro ni: {target}.
